content.title: The Rules of the Cheat and the Cheats Who Rule
content.abstract: The Rules of the Cheat and the Cheats Who RuleThis chapter begins with a conspicuously innocent observation: How is it that, today, so many far-right, authoritarian, "populist" politicians and personalities gain so much support for their programs by claiming to crack down on cheating when they are themselves transparently cheats?Donald Trump is only the most bombastic and successful example (Pilkington 2025).Here is a man whose whole career has been characterized by egregious scams, marital infidelity, and endless financial malfeasance (some of which has been legally prosecuted).Yet he was ele
